info.name: Bolum API
info.description: Bolum endpoints for authentication, football catalog CRUD, predictions, credits, profiles, integrations and browser sessions. Import the Bolum Local environment and use docs/POSTMAN.md for setup and request dependencies.

exec: const rows=pm.response.json().data; pm.test('At least one upcoming fixture',()=>pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.above(0)); if(rows.length){pm.environment.set('fixture_id',rows[0].id);pm.environment.set('team_id',rows[0].home_team.id);if(rows[0].season)pm.environment.set('season',rows[0].season);if(rows[0].matchday)pm.environment.set('matchday',rows[0].matchday);} if(rows.length>1)pm.environment.set('other_fixture_id',rows[1].id);

item.name: Generate prediction — creates a fresh key

request.description: Each send generates a NEW operation key and spends one demo credit if accepted. Use the replay request below to test a retry.

item.name: Replay SAME prediction — no second charge
Read saved prediction — send again until terminal

request.description: 202 means accepted. Keep a queue worker running and repeat this GET until completed or failed.
Expect one debit. An exhausted failed prediction refunds its credit; inspect the ledger.

item.name: Owner top-up — same key on retries

request.description: First send returns 201; identical retries return 200. Clear topup_key only for a new top-up.

item.name: Latest completed prediction for a fixture

request.description: Requires a completed prediction for this fixture; otherwise the API returns 404.

item.name: Login as member — retain owner token separately

request.description: Creates a real local test user/workspace on every send. Optional; do this only when testing isolation.
Requires an imported team and internet. 404 means no verified matching profile; 503 means configuration/upstream unavailable.
Requires an imported league and a configured football-data.org token.
Choose a past gameweek. Missing pre-kickoff forecasts are not retrospectively generated.
Requires an admin token, configured football-data.org token, and a running worker. Queues an import; missing configuration returns 409.

item.name: 5. Catalog CRUD
item.description: Requires an admin token. Run the create requests in order to populate the dedicated crud_* IDs. League, team and provider deletion endpoints do not exist in this API.

request.description: Creates a separate catalog league for these CRUD requests.

item.name: 7. Browser sessions and pages
item.description: Uses cookies, unlike the bearer-token API requests. Use the same base_url host throughout to preserve the session cookie.
